name: Slow Wardrobe
tagline: Buy less, choose well, wear it for years
about: Slow Wardrobe helps you buy fewer, better clothes: decode sustainability claims and fabric labels, calculate cost per wear, decide whether to repair, rework or replace, and run a 30-day challenge with what you own.
persona: You are a sustainable-fashion educator with a mending kit: evidence-led, budget-realistic, allergic to greenwashing and equally allergic to guilt-tripping.

onboarding.title: A wardrobe that lasts
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us how you shop today and what you want to change.

tools.title: Decode a sustainability claim
tools.subtitle: What the label really means

inputs.label: The claim or label text
inputs.placeholder: Conscious collection — made with 30% recycled polyester

tools.prompt: Analyse the claim '{claim}' from a {brand} brand. Table (Claim phrase | What it actually guarantees | What it leaves out | Question to ask), kv of certifications that would back it up (e.g. GOTS, Fairtrade, OEKO-TEX, B Corp, each with what it covers), bullets of red-flag phrases spotted, and a callout with a plain verdict on how much weight the claim deserves.

tools.title: Cost per wear
tools.subtitle: Is it worth the price?
tools.prompt: Calculate cost per wear for {item} at {wears} wears a year over {years} years. kv (cost per wear, break-even wears, cost per year), a table comparing it with a cheaper and a pricier alternative (Option | Price | Expected life | Cost per wear | Impact note), bullets of what would shorten its life, and a callout with a buy / wait / skip verdict for the profile's goal.

tools.title: Fabric decoder
tools.subtitle: Composition label → longevity and care

inputs.label: Photo of the composition / care label

tools.prompt: Read the fibre composition in the photo for a '{use}'. Table (Fibre | % | Durability | Care | Environmental note), text on whether this blend suits the use for comfort and longevity, bullets of better compositions to look for next time, and a callout on microfibre shedding and washing.

tools.title: Repair, rework or replace?
tools.subtitle: Photo of the damage → verdict

inputs.label: The item and how loved it is

tools.prompt: Assess the damage in the photo on '{item}' for the profile's mending skill. kv (verdict: repair / rework / replace, difficulty, time, cost at home versus tailor), steps for the repair or rework, a checklist of materials, and a callout on visible-mending styles if hiding the fix is not possible.

tools.title: 30-day wear challenge
tools.subtitle: A month of wearing what you own
tools.prompt: Design a 30-day challenge for the profile to wear only what they own, get neglected pieces to 30 wears and reset shopping habits. Table (Week | Theme | Daily prompt), a checklist for the setup (audit, wear log, no-buy rules), bullets of what to do when temptation hits, and a quote with a mantra for the month.
